chunks: And I have taken refuge in my Lord and your Lord against your stoning me.
ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Hud say to protect himself from his people's stoning?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah Al-Dukhan, Prophet Hud (peace be upon him) invokes divine protection from his people's threat of stoning, emphasizing that the Lord he serves is the same Lord they acknowledge. This highlights the continuity of prophetic mission and the specific fear of physical persecution faced by prophets in their own communities. The verse underscores the theme of steadfastness in the face of rejection, a recurring motif in Shia exegesis regarding the trials of the Imams and Prophets.
